introHtml: Tri blend fabric combines cotton, polyester, and rayon for a soft, lightweight feel that holds up to frequent washing. Marketing directors and HR teams often choose tri blend for employee uniforms or event giveaways because the material drapes well and accepts vibrant screen-printed or embroidered logos. Whether you need custom T-shirts for a company picnic or hoodies for a product launch, tri blend offers a premium look without the heavy weight of 100% cotton.
